code:
import zlib

ARRIVAL_MS = 2           # 每条消息到达间隔（固定，确定性）
RECORDS = 400
BYTES_PER_RECORD = 200
BATCH_BYTES = 16384
CAPACITY = BATCH_BYTES // BYTES_PER_RECORD     # 攒多少条能填满一个 batch


def batch_count(linger_ms):
    """返回 (批次数, 各批大小列表)。谁先满足谁触发：攒满 OR 等够 linger。"""
    sizes = []
    i = 0
    while i < RECORDS:
        if CAPACITY * ARRIVAL_MS <= linger_ms:
            take = min(CAPACITY, RECORDS - i)          # batch 先满
        else:
            take = min(max(1, linger_ms // ARRIVAL_MS), RECORDS - i)   # linger 先到
        sizes.append(take)
        i += take
    return len(sizes), sizes


print("=== linger.ms 与 batch.size 谁先触发（batch 容量 = %d 条）===" % CAPACITY)
print("%10s %10s %12s %12s" % ("linger.ms", "批次数", "平均批大小", "总耗时下限(ms)"))
base = None
for linger in (0, 5, 20, 100):
    n, sizes = batch_count(linger)
    lower = (n - 1) * linger + RECORDS * ARRIVAL_MS
    print("%10d %10d %12.1f %12d" % (linger, n, sum(sizes) / n, lower))
print("-> linger=0 时永远等不到 batch 攒满（一有数据立即发），所以调大 batch.size 单独无效")

print()
print("=== 批大小对真实压缩率的影响（zlib level 6，确定性）===")
payload = ("{" + ",".join(["\"field_%02d\":\"value_%02d\"" % (i % 12, i % 7) for i in range(10)]) + "}")


def compressed(batch_size):
    raw = (payload + "\n") * batch_size
    data = raw.encode("utf-8")
    comp = zlib.compress(data, 6)
    return len(data), len(comp), len(comp) / len(data)


print("%12s %12s %12s %10s" % ("batch 条数", "原始字节", "压缩后字节", "压缩率"))
for bs in (1, 5, 25, 100, 400):
    raw_b, comp_b, ratio = compressed(bs)
    print("%12d %12d %12d %9.2f%%" % (bs, raw_b, comp_b, ratio * 100))
print("-> 压缩是按 batch 整体做的: batch 越大, 重复字段名越能被摊薄, 压缩率越低越好")
